overallSummary: Staff-level engineer and AI platform architect with nearly 20 years across enterprise SaaS, distributed systems, and production infrastructure. Former Square engineer on fleet-wide software distribution and telemetry; now building governed agent runtimes, scoped-permission models, and evaluation harnesses for compliance-sensitive business workflows.
recommendedBullets: Architected a governed agent platform — a two-layer MCP surface where public discovery stays open and every state-changing action passes a scoped, expiring task grant checked against a tool allow-list, capability set, risk ceiling, and tenant scope, with everything else routed to a human approval inbox

Built a durable workflow runtime that analyzes inbound requests into structured results, binds each to executable plans, enforces reliability and approval rules, acts when permitted, and preserves a replayable audit trail — backed by leaseable job queues and long-running Fargate execution for work that exceeds serverless timeouts

Created an evaluation platform that generates scored eval cases, discovers recursive skill hierarchies, sweeps model and prompt configurations per skill, and emits typed TypeScript packages refined against real-world performance — the measurement substrate a workflow must pass before earning autonomy

Defined the reliability-tier model (trusted / assisted / review-only / unsafe) that caps how aggressive any automation may be, driven by pass rate, capability-reliability gap, confidence flags, failure severity, human-correction rate, and regression count

Maintained and evolved the fleet-wide software distribution and telemetry platform delivering updates across Square devices in merchants' hands, improving rollout visibility, failure diagnosis, and production reliability for endpoints businesses depend on daily

Designed Wanda at Unit4 — a distributed digital assistant aggregating functional business agents across an enterprise ERP, built as microservices on Azure Service Fabric with ASP.NET Web API, LUIS intent routing, durable conversation state, and Application Insights telemetry across 48,000+ lines of production C#

Owned language-understanding strategy and trained engineering teams in Poland, Spain, Sweden, and Norway — establishing reusable architectural approaches across organizational and cultural boundaries rather than one-off solutions

Delivered compliance-sensitive insurance workflow automation: 15+ email-driven agents on a serverless SES/Lambda/SQS/DynamoDB pipeline, a 200+ endpoint multi-tenant API on Aurora PostgreSQL, and document processing across COI, ACORD, loss-run, quote-comparison, underwriting, renewal, and claims workflows

Built the multi-tenant substrate underneath it all — Cognito/JWT auth with RBAC and passwordless magic-link flows, repository-level tenant isolation, versioned capability packs pinned into immutable tenant profiles, secret management with production-edit locks, and metered work units carrying cost, model usage, and entitlement per run

Delivered 250+ projects across enterprise platforms, developer tooling, ML infrastructure, real-time collaborative systems, and mobile — spanning TypeScript, Python, C#/.NET, React, and both AWS and Azure

topProjects.projectTitle: Agentic Commerce Platform & Governed MCP Gateway
topProjects.oneLiner: Multi-tenant platform that makes businesses readable and actionable to AI agents while keeping owners in final control — structured profiles, public discovery and protected MCP endpoints, scoped task grants, durable workflow runtime, and an evidence-backed trust layer.
bulletPoints: Architected a two-layer MCP surface: open, rate-limited public discovery for safe business facts, and a protected tenant gateway where every state-changing action passes a scoped task grant, tool allow-list, capability set, risk ceiling, tenant scope, and expiry check

Built a durable workflow runtime that analyzes an inbound request into structured results, binds each to executable plans, checks reliability and approval rules, acts when permitted, and routes everything else to an approval inbox or a clarifying question
Designed an append-only evidence ledger and policy-versioned trust snapshots so ratings are replayable and auditable rather than opaque scores
Implemented metered agentic work units tracking operation class, model and provider usage, cost, status, entitlement, and audit reference for every unit of agent work

Delivered the operator and owner surfaces: a business portal for MCP controls, agent access, deployment checks, usage and billing, plus an Electron operator workbench for profile generation and draft review

Added a versioned capability-pack and immutable per-tenant solution-profile layer so a capability is usable only at the intersection of catalogued, entitled, eligible, opted-in, reliable, and active — enforced fail-closed at every server surface

topProjects.oneLiner: Platform that iteratively builds, tests, and optimizes LLM solver libraries — generating eval cases, sweeping solver configurations, and emitting ready-to-publish TypeScript npm packages.
bulletPoints: Built an end-to-end pipeline: define a problem domain, auto-generate scored eval cases with checklists, discover a recursive skill hierarchy of arbitrary depth, and optimize solver configs via automated model/prompt/temperature sweeps

Generates production-ready typed npm packages from the winning configuration — nested routers plus leaf solvers with schema inference, parse validation, and retry logic — then refines the generated code against real eval cases

Established the grading vocabulary used platform-wide: capability vs. reliability vs. cap-reliability gap, hard verifiers (exact-match, json-match, regex) vs. soft verifiers (LLM judge, checklist), failure severity, and confidence flags for small-sample, high-variance, and bimodal results

Feeds a reliability gate that classifies every extractor, router, and workflow as trusted, assisted, review-only, or unsafe — capping how much autonomy a workflow is permitted to exercise in production

topProjects.oneLiner: TypeScript framework for building AI agents with tool calling — multi-provider, with both XML-based and native tool-calling paradigms and 35+ built-in tools.
bulletPoints: Designed a provider-agnostic agent runtime supporting Anthropic, OpenAI, and Groq with automatic continuation on truncated responses
Implemented a ReAct (Reason-Act-Observe) loop over 35+ built-in tools spanning file I/O, web, search, database, execution, and task management
Built a match-based surgical file-editing tool and automatic project-context discovery for code-aware agents

topProjects.projectTitle: Enterprise Conversational AI Platform with Multi-Agent Architecture
topProjects.oneLiner: Architected and developed a scalable enterprise digital assistant platform using Microsoft Bot Framework, Azure services, and LUIS NLP for intelligent conversation routing across multiple business domains.
bulletPoints: Designed and implemented multi-agent conversational AI system handling 3+ business domains (order management, travel requests, salutations) with LUIS-powered natural language understanding and intent classification
Architected scalable microservices platform using Azure Service Fabric, ASP.NET Web API, and OWIN middleware with support for multiple bot instances and Bearer token authentication
Built comprehensive data persistence layer using Azure Table Storage for conversation history, state management, and bot configurations with 48,000+ lines of production-ready C# code
highlights: Production-scale enterprise bot platform with 48K+ lines of code
Multi-agent architecture with intelligent conversation routing and state management

topProjects.oneLiner: Serverless CRUD and business-logic API for a multi-tenant agency management system, exposing 200+ endpoints from a single Lambda behind API Gateway.
bulletPoints: Built a single-Lambda API serving 200+ endpoints for entities, policies, certificates, documents, email, CRM boards, and AI services
Backed by Aurora PostgreSQL with S3 document storage and DynamoDB tenant config, fronted by API Gateway with Cognito JWT auth and per-tenant isolation
Bundled with esbuild into a single deployable artifact

topProjects.oneLiner: Architected and developed a comprehensive .NET-based distributed work processing framework with agent-based coordination, React Native mobile integration, and auto-generated validation systems across 82,000+ lines of code
bulletPoints: Engineered a distributed agent-worker architecture using ASP.NET Core and Autofac DI, implementing WorkerController and WorkerMinister components for scalable task distribution across multiple nodes
Built comprehensive validation framework with 15+ custom attributes (NumericIntAttribute, SocialSecurityAttribute) and auto-generated data models from JSON schemas for rapid application scaffolding
Developed full-stack solution spanning .NET Core backend services, React Native mobile starter templates, and RESTful APIs with Swagger documentation across 569 files
highlights: 82,000+ lines of production-ready distributed system code
Multi-platform architecture spanning backend services and mobile applications

topProjects.oneLiner: Event-driven email processing pipeline on AWS — inbound routing, dispatcher selection, and a unified processor with outbound replies — provisioned entirely as infrastructure-as-code.
bulletPoints: Architected an inbound/outbound email pipeline (SES receive -> S3 -> SQS -> router/dispatcher/processor Lambdas -> SES send)
Provisioned the full stack with Terraform and added standalone Node.js ingestion agents (policy summary, triage) that run without workspace coupling
Established a shared handler contract so domain agents plug into the pipeline uniformly

topProjects.oneLiner: Lead and opportunity discovery layer that ingests candidate businesses, normalizes them into a canonical model, enriches them with an LLM pass, and serves a faceted query product — now a metered multi-tenant SaaS.
bulletPoints: Built an industry-family model with per-family property extractors running a two-stage deterministic-fingerprint plus LAN-hosted-LLM semantic pass, with tombstoning for domains that yield nothing
Shipped a faceted query UI for non-technical operators: OR-within-facet / AND-across-facets filtering, deep-linkable state, map view, saved searches, lists, and CSV export
Added a metered SaaS shell — Cognito PKCE sign-in, a credit ledger, per-user multi-tenant scoping, and Stripe checkout with webhook grants that refuse stub grants in production
Made unattended imports resumable via durable cursor/keyset import cursors instead of copied offsets, and cached cross-product aggregations behind a stats projection

topProjects.oneLiner: Full-featured React/TypeScript web app for an insurance agency platform — client management, policy tracking, certificate generation, documents, CRM boards, and AI-assisted automation.
bulletPoints: Built a comprehensive agency platform UI spanning clients, policies, certificates, documents, CRM boards, and email sequences
Implemented a 3D relationship-intelligence network graph (WebGL/Three.js) and in-browser PDF rendering
Managed complex server state with TanStack Query and multi-context auth/tenant/business-unit scoping

topProjects.projectTitle: ML-Powered UI Element Recognition System for Browser Automation
topProjects.oneLiner: Developed a production-ready computer vision library using PyTorch and Siamese neural networks to enable robust UI element matching in web automation workflows, processing 5,000+ lines of Python code with distributed training capabilities.
bulletPoints: Architected and implemented a Siamese neural network with MobileNetV3-Small backbone achieving <2ms inference time and 2.5M parameters for real-time UI element recognition
Built distributed training infrastructure with remote GPU utilization and live progress streaming, supporting PK batch sampling (32 identities × 4 samples) with NT-Xent contrastive loss
Developed comprehensive data pipeline from capture to production deployment including ONNX export with quantization for optimized CPU inference
highlights: Custom distributed training system with remote GPU coordination
